name: carea
description: Autonomous reverse engineering orchestrator running Stage 1 (/rea) -> Stage 2 (/ca study-only, zero auto-build) -> Stage 3 (architecture, design-system, and full breakdown), with optional two-team clean-room airlock CLI gates.

interface.longDescription: Unofficial Level-1 skill pack and airlock CLI coordinating external REA and Craft Anything engines across single-command architecture/design extraction, clean-room rebuild specs, and dual-axis parity checks.
defaultPrompt: Use /carea on this authorized APK, website, or binary to extract architecture.md, design-system.md, and build plan.
Use /carea in clean-room two-team mode with airlock lint/sign and parity verification.
Use /rea to inspect a binary or bundle and export an evidence bundle.
Use /ca to capture and rebuild an authorized web interface cleanly.
